HEIC decoder: heic-to 1.5.2, libheif 1.22.2, libde265 1.0.16.
libheif.js is an UNMODIFIED copy of src/lib/libheif-without-unsafe-eval.js
from the heic-to 1.5.2 npm package. SHA-256 is recorded in the release notes.
Built upstream with USE_UNSAFE_EVAL=0; no WebAssembly or eval permission needed.

License: LGPL-3.0-or-later; see LICENSE.txt and GPL-3.0.txt.
Source and build instructions:
https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to/tree/v1.5.2
https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.5.2.tgz
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif
https://github.com/strukturag/libde265

The application imports this separate library at runtime. An interface-compatible
modified library may replace libheif.js; no integrity lock prevents replacement.
No user images are sent to the library publisher or a conversion service.
